# Gravity For AI

> Gravity For AI is an applied AI engineering consultancy based in Mansa, Punjab, India. We design, deploy, and manage done-for-you AI voice agents, high-conversion websites, and autonomous agentic workflows for local and growing businesses.

## Organization Details
- **Entity Name:** Gravity For AI
- **Founder & Lead Engineer:** Harsimran Singh (AI Engineer, specializing in Agentic AI and LLM architectures)
- **Headquarters:** Mansa, Punjab 151505, India
- **Primary Market:** Mansa, Bathinda, Barnala, Ludhiana, Jalandhar, Amritsar, Chandigarh, Mohali, Panchkula, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, Gandhinagar, Surat, Kolkata, and Global Tier-2 Markets (USA & Germany)
- **Website:** https://gravity4ai.com
- **Contact:** contact@gravity4ai.com

## Core Capabilities & Canonical Definitions

### 1. AI Voice Agents
- **Definition:** Done-for-you neural AI voice receptionists that handle telephone calls 24/7 with human-like cadence, pauses, and tone in English, Hindi, and Punjabi.
- **Key Functions:** Pick up instantly on zero hold time, answer inquiries, qualify leads, and book appointments directly into Google Calendar and CRM software.
- **Link:** https://gravity4ai.com/services/ai-voice-agents

### 2. Website Development
- **Definition:** High-performance, mobile-first websites built with Next.js 14 and Tailwind CSS, engineered specifically for sub-2s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and high inquiry conversion.
- **Key Functions:** StoryBrand 7-step persuasion architecture, LocalBusiness schema, and integrated audit booking flows.
- **Link:** https://gravity4ai.com/services/website-development

### 3. Agentic AI Systems
- **Definition:** Coordinated autonomous multi-agent software pipelines that complete complex multi-step back-office tasks end-to-end without requiring continuous human prompting.
- **Key Functions:** Automated inquiry parsing, database cross-referencing, multi-system synchronization, and human-in-the-loop validation checkpoints.
- **Link:** https://gravity4ai.com/services/agentic-ai-systems
